text: dsh-exit-code-lens 是一个面向 DSH 的工具结果与系统提示词插件，在 bash 工具执行后检查命令、退出码和 stderr，并为已知表示正常答案的非零退出码补充说明。它识别 grep 无匹配、diff 有差异、test 条件为假、命令未找到等情形，将说明加在原退出码标记之前，并可向系统提示词加入解释。插件支持配置目标工具、自定义命令规则以及是否启用提示词说明，适合希望 agent 不再反复核查这些命令结果的 DSH 用户。使用前需要 Node.js 24.9.0 或更高版本；代码未显示 API key 或外部服务配置。

dsh-exit-code-lens annotates harmless non-zero bash results for DSH. It explains cases such as no grep matches, differing files, or a false test, and can add system-prompt guidance. Custom rules are supported. It helps agents continue without rechecking. Requires Node.js 24.9.0 or newer.
grep 没搜到内容时，别让 agent 把它当成命令故障反复检查。
让 DSH 根据 diff 的退出状态理解文件确实有差异并继续。
Help my DSH agent treat a false test result as an answer instead of rerunning the command.
dsh-exit-code-lens 的功能「解释正常的非零退出码」：工具执行后识别已知命令及其退出状态，并把简短解释插入结果的退出码标记之前；stderr 非空、超时或无法确认时不添加说明。

dsh-exit-code-lens README · dsh-exit-code-lens：A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that stops the agent from "investigating" commands that worked.

中文：很多命令用非零退出码表示「答案」而不是「失败」：`grep` 没搜到返回 1，`diff` 有差异返回 1，`test` 为假返回 1。dsh 会把这类结果标成 `[exit code: 1]`、卡片变红，系统提示词又要求模型「每个 bash 结果都检查 exit code，出错先排查」，于是模型反复重跑、核查，白白浪费轮次和 token。这个插件在结果里补一行说明，告诉模型这不是错误，可以继续。

dsh-exit-code-lens README · The problem：dsh's bash tool appends `[exit code: N]` to every non-zero result, and its system prompt says *"Check the [exit code: N] marker on every bash result; investigate failures before moving on."* So when `grep -rn TODO src` finds nothing, the model treats "no matches" as a failure and goes digging: re-running the search, listing directories, checking the file exists.

dsh-exit-code-lens README · The problem：Community reports:
- [Discussion #1884](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1884): a third-party eval where an exit-1 loop roughly doubled requests (61 vs 32) on the same task.
- [Discussion #8403](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/8403): 7 of 56 tool results in one session were exit 1, all from how the command was written, not real errors.

dsh-exit-code-lens README · What it does：After every `bash` call it checks the command and exit code. When the status is a known *answer*, it adds one line above the marker:

```
(no output)
[exit-code note: grep exits 1 when no line matched. Nothing failed; the answer is "no matches".]
[exit code: 1]
```

The `[exit code: N]` marker stays the last line, so the terminal card still shows the exit pill. It also adds one sentence to the system prompt so the model knows to trust the note.

Built-in rules (exit 1 only):

dsh-exit-code-lens README · What it does：| Command | Meaning of exit 1 |
|---|---|
| `grep` `egrep` `fgrep` `zgrep` `rg` `ag` `ack` `git grep` | no matches |
| `diff` `cmp` `git diff --exit-code/--quiet` | inputs differ |
| `test` `[` `[[` | condition is false |
| `which` `type` `command -v` `hash` | not installed |
| `pgrep` `pidof` | no such process |
| `git merge-base --is-ancestor` | not an ancestor |
| `jq -e` | last output false/null |

dsh-exit-code-lens README · When it stays quiet：Leading `VAR=x`, `env`, `sudo`, `timeout N`, `nice -n N` and redirects like `2>/dev/null` are looked through. For pipelines or `cd x && grep …` the note adds "(Assuming the status came from the last command.)"

dsh-exit-code-lens README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:YanYunCY/dsh-exit-code-lens
```

Requires Node ≥ 24.9. Tested with dsh 0.2.1-rc.5. No build step, no runtime dependencies, no network access.
dsh-exit-code-lens README · Configure (optional)：```yaml

dsh-exit-code-lens README · $DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml：- id: exit-code-lens
  config:
    tools: [bash]          # tool names to annotate
    prompt: true           # add the one-line system-prompt hint
    rules:                 # your own tools, checked before the built-ins
      - command: mytool
        subcommand: check
        codes: [3]
        note: "{cmd} exits {code} when the check is still pending. Nothing failed."
```

dsh-exit-code-lens README · Cost：One extra line per matching result, and one sentence (~70 tokens) in the system prompt. The prompt sentence is static, so it does not break the KV cache between requests. Set `prompt: false` to drop it.

dsh-exit-code-lens README · Does it help? (measured)：We ran 4 tasks that lead the model into `grep`, `diff`, `git diff --exit-code` and `test -f` returning 1, 3 times each, with and without the plugin, on DeepSeek's official API (2026-11-05):

| Model | Steps (off / on) | Tool calls (off / on) |
|---|---|---|
| `deepseek-flash` | 30 / 30 | 18 / 19 |
| `deepseek-v4-pro` | 24 / 24 | 12 / 12 |

dsh-exit-code-lens README · Does it help? (measured)：Today's official models already took exit 1 at face value on these simple tasks, so the plugin made **no measurable difference** there, and the prompt sentence costs a few percent more input tokens. It is aimed at older, smaller or relayed models that do loop on harmless exit codes (as in the reports above). If your model doesn't loop, you don't need it.

中文：在官方 `deepseek-flash` 与 `deepseek-v4-pro` 上实测无差异（模型本身已不会被 exit 1 带偏）。本插件主要面向较旧、较小或经中转的、仍会反复核查的模型。

dsh-exit-code-lens README · What it does not do：- It does not hide the exit code or turn the card green. The model still sees the real status.
- It does not cover PowerShell or Windows `cmd` yet.
